findings.title: The objection's mandatory measurement is still unproduced — no zero-failure run of tests/test_drive.sh exists for this candidate
drive_delivery_is_noop reads HEAD only, so a dispatch that edited files without committing is journalled as "delivered nothing" and its relaunch inherits the dirty worktree
kernel.md's transition table now states an implementing→testing precondition that `orchid task advance` neither checks nor can check, since the driver overwrites candidate_sha before advancing
